# opwan_firewall (Data Source)

The inbound firewall of one of the account's addresses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opwan_firewall" "this" {
  ip = "72.244.89.10"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) One of the account's addresses (dotted IPv4).

### Read-Only

- `default_action` (String) What happens to inbound traffic no rule matches: `allow` or `deny`.
- `id` (String) The address, same as `ip`.
- `rules` (Attributes List) The rules in order, first match wins. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) `allow` or `deny`.
- `ports` (String) Ports and ranges in normal form (`"80, 443"`), null for every port.
- `protocol` (String) `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp` or `any`.
- `source` (String) The IPv4 address or CIDR the traffic must come from, null for anywhere.
